title: engine/ready
description: Engine-to-shell notification, sent once after the `initialize` answer (brief 0038): the engine's Chrome DevTools remote debugging port answers. The engine chose a free port on 127.0.0.1 before CefInitialize (CEF binds the DevTools HTTP and websocket server to 127.0.0.1 only) and sends this once `GET /json/version` on it answered. A debugger (vscode-js-debug's `pwa-chrome` attach) reaches the engine's tabs there; the shell never guesses the port. Absent when the port did not answer within 10 s (the engine logs why on stderr): the tabs then cannot be debugged.

remoteDebuggingPort.description: The remote debugging port (CEF accepts 1024 to 65534).

address.description: Where it listens: always the loopback address.
